summary: Iteration 140: Tested Cloud Recording Storage and Enhanced Webinar Analytics features. All 14 backend API tests passed. All frontend features verified working: Recordings page with stat cards (Total, Duration, Cloud, Storage), recording list with Local badges, Webinars page with analytics button on each card, and analytics dialog showing engagement score, attendance funnel, Q&A stats, and organization breakdown.

issues: Minor: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle accessibility. Not blocking, but should add aria labels for screen reader users.

backend_apis.recordings_list: PASS - GET /api/karau-meet/recordings/ returns recordings with storage_type field (cloud/browser_local)
backend_apis.recordings_stats: PASS - GET /api/karau-meet/recordings/stats returns total_recordings, cloud_count, local_count, total_size_bytes, total_duration_seconds
backend_apis.recordings_upload: PASS - POST /api/karau-meet/recordings/upload accepts multipart form data and stores in cloud
backend_apis.recordings_metadata: PASS - POST /api/karau-meet/recordings/metadata saves local recording metadata with storage_type=browser_local
backend_apis.recordings_download_local_error: PASS - GET /api/karau-meet/recordings/download/{id} returns 400 for local recordings
backend_apis.webinar_analytics_structure: PASS - GET /api/karau/webinar/{id}/analytics returns webinar_id, title, status
backend_apis.webinar_analytics_funnel: PASS - Analytics contains funnel with total_registrations, attended, missed, attendance_rate, drop_off_rate
backend_apis.webinar_analytics_qa_stats: PASS - Analytics contains qa_stats with total_questions, pending, answered, dismissed, anonymous, total_upvotes, answer_rate, top_questions
backend_apis.webinar_analytics_engagement: PASS - Analytics contains engagement with score (0-100), peak_attendees, avg_watch_time_minutes
backend_apis.webinar_analytics_org_breakdown: PASS - Analytics contains org_breakdown array with org and count
backend_apis.webinar_analytics_timeline: PASS - Analytics contains registration_timeline array with date and count

frontend_ui.webinars_list: PASS - Shows 5 webinar cards with Ended/Scheduled badges
frontend_ui.webinars_analytics_button: PASS - BarChart3 icon button on each card opens analytics dialog
frontend_ui.analytics_dialog_opens: PASS - Clicking analytics button opens modal dialog
frontend_ui.analytics_engagement_score: PASS - Engagement Score card shows 0/100 with progress bar
frontend_ui.analytics_attendance_funnel: PASS - Attendance Funnel shows Registered/Attended/Missed with bars and percentages

critical_code_review_comments: Recordings API correctly distinguishes between 'cloud' and 'browser_local' storage types
Cloud upload uses Emergent Object Storage with graceful fallback if budget is low
Webinar analytics endpoint returns comprehensive data: funnel, qa_stats, engagement, org_breakdown, registration_timeline
All data-testid attributes in place for recordings page stat cards
Minor accessibility warnings in analytics dialog (DialogTitle) - non-blocking
seed_data_creation: Created TEST recordings via API for upload/delete testing (cleaned up)
